indications: Desloratadine tablets are histamine-1 (H1) receptor antagonist indicated for: Seasonal Allergic Rhinitis: relief of nasal and non-nasal symptoms in patients 12 years of age and older. ( 1.1 ) Perennial Allergic Rhinitis: relief of nasal and non-nasal symptoms in patients 12 years of age and older. ( 1.2 )
contraindications: Dosage (by age): Adults and Adolescents 12 Years of Age and Over: Desloratadine Tablets - one 5 mg tablet once daily
